title: LibChainlinkOracle.getTokenPrice NatSpec states lookback>0 returns TWAP, but the ternary returns spot for lookback>0 and divides-by-zero for lookback==0
description: The NatSpec on getTokenPrice (lines 34-36) explicitly documents the intended behavior: 'Use lookback = 0 for the instantaneous price. lookback > 0 for a TWAP.' and 'Returns 0 if priceAggregatorAddress is broken or frozen.' The code implements the exact opposite mapping: `return lookback > 0 ? getPrice(...) : getTwap(..., lookback)`. getPrice is the instantaneous/spot path and getTwap is the lookback-windowed path, so a caller requesting a manipulation-resistant TWAP (lookback>0) silently receives a flash-loan-manipulable spot price, and a caller requesting spot (lookback==0) invokes getTwap with lookback=0 whose final statement is `t.cumulativePrice.mul(PRECISION).div(10 ** decimals).div(lookback)` — a division by zero that REVERTS rather than returning the documented 0 sentinel. Both halves of the NatSpec contract are violated: the value semantics are inverted, and the documented frozen-feed graceful-degradation guarantee does not hold on the lookback==0 path.
impact: Any internal consumer that follows the documented convention and passes lookback>0 expecting manipulation resistance instead consumes the instantaneous spot price. If a reachable mint/convert/peg path (LibEthUsdOracle -> LibWellMinting/LibDeltaB -> sunrise Bean issuance / convert valuation) requests a TWAP through this function, single-block flash-loan reserve/price skew mispriced Bean issuance and conversions. The lookback==0 spot path additionally bricks (reverts) instead of degrading, contradicting the '@dev Returns 0 if broken or frozen' guarantee for that path.

ite.intent: Stated intent: return a manipulation-resistant TWAP when lookback>0 and a spot price when lookback==0, returning 0 on a broken feed.
ite.technique: Ternary branches transposed; consumer relying on lookback>0 for safety receives manipulable spot. Spot request (lookback==0) reverts via div-by-zero.
ite.evasion: The inversion defeats the only manipulation guard; a flash-loan attacker requests/relies on a path the protocol believes is TWAP-protected.

ice_chain.corrupted_state: oracle return value: spot price substituted where a TWAP is documented (and revert where a 0-sentinel is documented)
ice_chain.impact: Manipulable price flows into Bean minting/convert peg math; or feed-outage DoS of the spot path
ice_chain.consumer_function: LibEthUsdOracle/LibUsdOracle.getTokenPrice -> LibWellMinting/LibDeltaB deltaB & peg calculations feeding SeasonFacet.sunrise mint and ConvertFacet valuation
ice_chain.exploit_path: consumer calls getTokenPrice(addr, timeout, lookback>0) believing it gets a TWAP -> receives spot -> attacker flash-loan-skews the source within one block -> sunrise/convert mint mispriced Beans/BDV
